question: To which eye endpoints do the gāndhārī and hastijihvā channels extend?
premises: Gāndhārī is assigned a termination point.
Hastijihvā is assigned a termination point.
The endpoints are the left eye and the other eye.
inference: Gāndhārī extends to the end of the left eye and hastijihvā extends to the other eye.
uncertainties: The form itarākṣikāḥ is read as indicating the other eye endpoint.
plain_english: Gāndhārī reaches the end of the left eye, and hastijihvā reaches the other eye.
